item: Windows observation fixes: airplane test errno, analytics45 sendmsg tripwire, file-mode comparisons, thesaurus hash memo on Windows, Popen stub as a subclass
summary: The airplane failure was test-only (socket.EAI_ADDRFAMILY does not exist on Windows; the guard was never reached). Product: on Windows st_ctime_ns is the creation time, so the thesaurus hash memo could answer ok for a same-size rewrite with its old mtime put back; there the hash is now read on every status (load_thesaurus already refused the bytes). The env-passphrase import test failed because asyncio.windows_utils subclasses subprocess.Popen, which the child had replaced with a function. Row 155 folded in: the keyword-triage outage test got row 147's isolation; node output read as UTF-8; posix paths; the rollup swap test replaces a held file only off Windows (the product's Windows path is R741, tested in test_swap_refused_while_held); self_update asserts the documented Windows rollback_incomplete (a half-rolled-back tree with a visible note, raised as its own product row).
